perspective:
RECOMMENDER knows:

- The other person opened with “Hi.”
- I greeted them and asked what kind of movie they like.
- They asked me to recommend a great movie, and said they liked *Good Will Hunting* (1997).
- I told them my all-time favorite is *The Outsiders* (1983).
- They said they’d seen that a while back.
- They said it was good.
- I said it depends on what type of movie they want to watch.
- They then asked for any movies I like and would recommend — specifically my top three.

I have not yet given them my top three list.
